Class Hl7Utils

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.utilities.Hl7Utils

    • extractHl7Cx

      public static org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Identifier extractHl7Cx(String value)
      extracts Identifier from passed String value. Value is Hl7v2 CX format. This looks like {ID}^^^&{OID}&ISO
      Parameters:
      value - Hl7v2 CX formatted ID
      Returns:
      extracted Identifier

    • extractHl7Xcn

      public static org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.HumanName extractHl7Xcn(String value)
      extracts HumanName from passed String value. Value is Hl7v2 XCN format. This looks like {ID}^{family}^{given}^{further given}^{suffix}^{prefix}^^^{assigning authority}&&ISO
      Parameters:
      value - Hl7v2 XCN formatted name
      Returns:
      extracted HumanName

    • extractHl7Xad

      public static org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Address extractHl7Xad(String value)
      extracts Address from passed String value. Value is Hl7v2 XAD format. This looks like {street address}^{other designation}^{city}^{state or province}^{postal code}^{country}
      Parameters:
      value - Hl7v2 XAD formatted address
      Returns:
      extracted Address
